faq.question: How do I create a travel plan?
faq.answer: You can create a plan by choosing your destination, number of days, and preferred places. The app will help you organize everything day by day.

faq.question: Can I create more than one plan?
faq.answer: Yes. You can create multiple plans and switch between them from the Plan screen.

faq.question: How do I switch between my plans?
faq.answer: Go to the Plan screen, tap the current plan name, then choose another plan from the list.

faq.question: Can I add a new place to my plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap the plus button, choose "Add Place", then search for a place or use AI suggestions.

faq.question: Can I delete a place from my plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap the plus button, choose "Delete Place", then select the places you want to remove.

faq.question: Can the AI help me build a plan?
faq.answer: Yes. The AI can suggest places, routes, and daily itineraries based on your trip duration and interests.

faq.question: Can I use the chatbot for travel questions?
faq.answer: Yes. You can ask the chatbot about landmarks, routes, best visiting times, costs, and travel tips.

faq.question: What does "Total Budget" mean?
faq.answer: It shows the estimated total cost of the places and activities added to your current plan.

faq.question: Can I save my favorite landmarks?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap the heart icon on any landmark card to save it to your favorites.

faq.question: Can I add a landmark directly to my plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the landmark details page and tap "Add to My Plan" or "Plan Your Visit".

faq.question: What happens if I add a new day?
faq.answer: A new empty day will be created. You can then add places manually or generate suggestions with AI.

faq.question: Can I edit my profile information?
faq.answer: Yes. Go to Profile, then Account Settings, and update your name, photo, email, phone, or bio.

faq.question: Can I manage my payment methods?
faq.answer: Yes. You can add new cards, view saved cards, and choose your default payment method from Payment Methods.

faq.question: How do I contact support?
faq.answer: Go to Help Center and choose Live Chat or Contact Support.

faq.question: Can I change the app language?
faq.answer: Yes. You can change the language from the Edit Profile or Account Settings screen.
